rows.content_description: Sources for the classical small Ramsey number R(3,4)=9: Greenwood-Gleason 1955 (Combinatorial relations and chromatic graphs), Radziszowski's Small Ramsey Numbers dynamic survey, and later small-Ramsey computations / explicit K_8 witness and exhaustive K_9 check.
